collection.title: Lexus GS Series GS 450H 1997 to 2011 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Lexus GS 450H Series 1997 to 2012 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. There is the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
